about: The starter kit: the code this plugin can give a repository, each piece with the need it answers, its kind, the files of templates/owned it is made of, and the kinds of adapter it needs. find offers a piece only where the repository has every adapter it needs. A component is one part a screen draws; a block is a few files that give a screen a whole way of working. The guide installs these files on the floor when its conditions hold; this table says what each one is for.

items.name: TypedTable
items.description: Table parts that take alignment, width and row height from the column type of a data field, so no screen sets them itself.

items.name: TableActions
items.description: The column that holds a row's actions and no data, and stays in view while a wide table scrolls sideways.

items.name: RowActions
items.description: One button on a row that opens two or more of its actions as a list of buttons, the same at every width.

items.name: HeldLabel
items.description: The words on a control while its action waits, keeping the control's width so nothing beside it moves.

items.name: WithRecord
items.description: How one record of a list opens, beside the list or over it, with the open record kept in the address so a link opens it and Back closes it.

items.name: useList
items.description: What every list screen does the same way: load the items, try again after a failure, filter by name, and change one item in place.

items.name: AppFrame
items.description: The application's frame: the one region a person moves between screens from, drawn once around every screen.

items.name: notifyDone
items.description: The one way a screen tells a person what an action did: a short message, through one module, so no screen calls the message library itself.
